Home Turf

Find where your people watch the game, in any city.
AI agents find, verify, and map every fan club's bar, plan your whole season, and help clubs and bars team up.

Noah Silver  ·  github.com/noah-silver/home-turf

The problem

It's Saturday. You're in Chicago. Where do Yale fans watch The Game?

📍

The traveling fan

Googles “Yale bar Chicago,” digs through Reddit threads and fan blogs of unknown age, and still can't tell if the club still meets there.

🏈

The club president

A volunteer who vets bars by hand every season: sound on for our game, the right channels, room for 70, and no clash with another club.

🍺

The bar

Wants a 70-fan club filling the room every game day, but has no way to find clubs or prove it's the right home.

64%of sports fans don't live in their team's city1
~500Bills Backers chapters; ~275 Notre Dame clubs2
18.2Mwatched the 2026 Super Bowl at a bar or restaurant3

1 Digital Center 2019 · 2 Buffalo Bills 2022; Notre Dame · 3 NRF 2026

What's new

Today it takes five tabs and a guess. Home Turf takes one search.

Today

  • Team bar maps cover one team each (Steelers, Packers, Bills)
  • Alumni pages list one school, one event at a time
  • Yelp & Google don't know which bar hosts which club
  • ChatGPT search answers, but doesn't verify (60%+ wrong on citations4)
  • Presidents and bars find each other by cold calls
→

Home Turf

  • Any team, any city: 60 teams mapped across 6 cities so far
  • Every spot re-checked against its source and labeled Verified / Likely
  • City map of team logos, filterable by league
  • My Season: a bar for every game, wherever you'll be
  • Clubs ⇄ bars marketplace: season matching, rivalry parties, pitches

4 Columbia Journalism Review, Tow Center, 2025 (news citations)

Feature 1 · Find your people

Every team's fans in a city, on one map

1234
  1. League filter: NFL, NCAA, MLB, NBA, NHL, Soccer
  2. Teams in this city, toggle any team (folds away)
  3. Team-logo pins, ringed green when verified; click for the bar
  4. Search a team + city, or just a city; popular searches load instantly
Feature 2 · My season

Tell it where you'll be. Get a bar for every game.

1234
  1. “Home in New Haven, NYC for Columbia, Chicago for The Game”
  2. A bar, backup, and local kickoff for each game, in each city
  3. Add to calendar (.ics)

Feature 3 · Clubs ⇄ bars

Presidents pick a home bar. Rivals share one.

Bars get a dashboard too: claim a profile and send pitches the Pitch Writer drafts only from what the bar actually offers.

How it works

12 agents, fixed pipelines, people decide

All on gpt-6-luna via Portkey · code does the facts (addresses, capacity, clashes, times), the model does judgment · nothing is booked or sent by an agent

Cost & safety

About a penny a search, and hard to fool

$0.014per new search (8 measured runs)
$0repeat search, from cache
$137AI per month for 10,000 users
web-search fee 90%
tokens
  • Cache first: repeat team + city searches skip the model entirely
  • Free code checks before any model call; search caps; low reasoning effort
  • Experiment: 1 web search vs 3 was 12% cheaper, same quality
  • Spend caps per request, session, and day
  • Hidden instructions in reviews are blocked before any tokens are spent
  • Pitches can't promise what a bar doesn't offer ("$1 beers, 300 TVs")
  • The model never writes addresses or pins · 24/24 tests pass
Impact & business model

Fans stay free. Bars and alumni groups pay.

~7 sto a sourced answer for a new team + city
7/8new searches found a verified spot
$25kseason revenue for a bar from one 70-fan club (est.)
<1%of revenue goes to AI at 10,000 users

Bar Pro · $49/mo

Pitch clubs, season and rivalry bookings, a labeled Featured slot, demand analytics (“212 Packers fans searched near you”).

Alumni licensing · $5–25k/yr

A white-label watch-party finder and season matchmaking for every chapter, from the Yale Alumni Association to Bills Backers.

One trust rule

Money buys visibility (labeled), never a Verified badge or a higher match score.
